name: Autoresearch baseline failed → stamp agent.run.outcome=failed (run-anchor)
description:
ADR-053 Phase 4a′ — autoresearch run-failed mapping, anchor branch 1 of 2 (the baseline). The baseline runs once at the start of an autoresearch run to establish the measurement; if it fails involuntarily (agent.loop.outcome in [failed, truncated]) the run cannot proceed and must fail, not hang `executing`.

WHY baseline is split from the other autoresearch roles (the §E anchor asymmetry): autoresearch-baseline is spawned by rule 01 with run_scope=new, so it carries agent.run.entity-id (framework-stamped from RunID, graph_writer.go:535-539) but NO agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id. The propose/synthesize/reviewer roles are spawned by the RUN-entity-fired iteration driver (rule 05) and so carry agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id but NOT agent.run.entity-id — they are handled by the sibling rule 13. Stamping a single lineage-subject across the mixed role list would write the baseline's failed marker to an unresolved literal token and the run would never fail (the go-reviewer C1 garbage-subject class). So baseline uses its own anchor here.

Companion to autoresearch/11-loop-failed-pause (operator chain.paused.marker, untouched). autoresearch-execute stays EXCLUDED from both — a loop-failed execute is a budgeted iteration routed through rule 04b (counter increments, chain continues); it must NOT fail the run. The failed source loop is retained as an immutable reply fact. Only the failed-run origin handoff requests a user-facing summary; execute failures remain budgeted and excluded.

metadata.role: autoresearch baseline run-failed mapping (anchor branch 1: agent.run.entity-id)
metadata.split_rationale: baseline (run_scope=new, rule 01) carries agent.run.entity-id; propose/synthesize/reviewer (run-entity-fired, rule 05) carry agent.lineage.run-loop-entity-id → rule 13. Same anchor asymmetry as the success path and as dev-via-test 02 vs 02g.
metadata.anchor_guard: agent.run.entity-id != "" ensures the stamp subject resolves (defends the C1 garbage-literal-subject class).
metadata.budgeted_exclusion: autoresearch-execute is NOT here — budgeted loop-failure via rule 04b keeps the run executing.
metadata.reply_contract: Failed run forwards the full source loop ID to its canonical origin; no direct orphan coordinator is published.
metadata.anchor_fence: Exactly one source run anchor is required; ambiguous multi-run values never use first-value selection for reply handoff.
